t: This is Blackfriars Road in Southwark. It runs from St George's Circus at the southern end up to Blackfriars Bridge over the Thames, which leads into the City of London. Halfway along on the west side is Southwark Underground station, on the corner with The Cut. Opposite stands Palestra, a large office building housing Transport for London's surface transport division. James Lowe, the English inventor of a screw propeller, died here in 1866.
